value.rationale: Constructive robust counterexample isolates a genuinely motivated mechanism: monotone, intrinsically stabilizing recruitment can exhibit sustained antiphase cycles solely through nonlinear migration, despite all constant-migration variants converging. Exact rational stability and a perturbation-open witness are reusable structural facts in patch-population dynamics; not an unsupported claim of generic oscillation.
